scope: Inventory plus initial propagation review; partial is not a completed semantic audit. A no-op fixture is not proof of every transformation.
fallback: Unannotated writes invalidate their node origin; new nodes are unknown unless attributed explicitly.

Nested scalar leaves retain initializer and separate lookup-use ranges. Missing keys use lookup origin; unknown source leaves stay unknown. Survivor declaration slots and unaffected subtrees are preserved.

Shared expression-copy/substitution preserves function-body origins, actual argument origins and related call/parameter sites. Statement fusion, literal-result special cases and other rewrites still need dedicated attribution.

Rebuilt source subtrees keep explicit origins; alias references derive from the original builtin access; alias definitions are explicitly synthetic.

Named fields, dot accesses and method occurrences retain per-site original names. Quoted identifiers use exact original literal ranges without inventing name spellings. Missing quoted-key origins invalidate enclosing fallback instead of claiming table-wide precision.

additionalStages.notes: New value roots derive from the original property call.
The shared lexical emitter records exact copied-token ranges; whitespace remains unmapped.
An unmodified source candidate carries its original snapshot and full-source group range.
Shared block-statement filtering changes only affected block attribution; inspecting unrelated nodes no longer invalidates their origins. Owning complex passes still require their separate audits.
